The '''Pavo Prime system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] region.<ref name="TEAOC" /> It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Pavo Prime/Legends|Pavo Prime]].
